subject.title: [Feature]: Cloud Relay — openclaw login + heartbeat + relay for remote mobile access

question: Should OpenClaw core adopt a first-party OAuth cloud relay for mobile Gateway connectivity, and what trust, storage, and backend ownership model should it use?
rationale: This cannot be decided from code alone because it changes remote Gateway ingress, persistent credentials, config schema, mobile pairing, and official cloud/backend ownership.

options.title: Sponsor relay design first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require maintainer-approved security/product design before any implementation PR.

options.title: Defer to current remote access
options.body: Keep Tailscale Serve/Funnel and SSH/direct remote access as the supported path and close or narrow this proposal later.

options.title: Move API-first or plugin-first
options.body: Define only the missing extension/API seams in core and let a cloud relay implementation live outside core until proven official.

recommendation.title: Sponsor relay design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require maintainer-approved security/product design before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current mobile relay and Gateway identity delegation work is the hosted iOS APNs relay owned in recent history by this contributor.
